name: r7-s-r8w4-cta128-disp
author: solx-loop
description: For B*S <= 600, use the parent's one-shot 256-bit kernel with 8-row, 128-thread CTAs (16 resident per SM), so placement is finer-grained and each SM's load is more even. Every larger size runs the parent kernel with its exact configuration. This was the best of five S-band structures tried on a rented B200; the gain is within noise there.
